name: Contact Sync for Euromsg
author: Dixjuin Digital Agency & Software Solutions

sections.description:
Contact Sync for Euromsg connects WordPress, WooCommerce, and Elementor form submissions to the Related Digital Euromsg Member API.

The plugin is designed around a local queue instead of sending every contact blindly. Contacts are normalized, deduplicated by email hash, checked against local suppression records, and then sent to the configured Euromsg list when synchronization is enabled.

Free version features:

  • Sync WooCommerce order customers.
  • Sync Elementor form subscribers by matching form keywords.
  • Import contacts from CSV into the local queue.
  • Prevent duplicate contacts with email hashes.
  • Refresh remote suppression signals from Euromsg.
  • Store API password encrypted with WordPress salts.
  • Provide admin dashboard, queue status, recent records, logs, and manual controls.

The plugin does not include Euromsg credentials. Site administrators must have their own Related Digital Euromsg account and Member API credentials.

This plugin is developed by Dixjuin Digital Agency & Software Solutions. It is not an official Euromsg or Related Digital product and is not endorsed by Euromsg or Related Digital.

External services

This plugin connects to the Related Digital Euromsg Member API when a site administrator saves API credentials and enables synchronization, runs a connection test, manually processes the queue, refreshes suppressions, or when enabled WooCommerce/Elementor events trigger a queued sync.

By default, API requests are sent to:

  • https://express-crm-gw.relateddigital.com

Data sent to the external service may include:

  • Email address.
  • First name.
  • Last name.
  • Source type, such as WooCommerce order or Elementor form.
  • Source reference and local queue metadata.

The plugin uses the /tokens, /{apiKey}/identification, /{apiKey}/list, /{apiKey}/member/{listId}/members, and related Member API endpoints.

The service is provided by Related Digital / Euromsg. Site owners are responsible for reviewing the service terms and privacy policy and for ensuring they have the required consent or legal basis before syncing contact data.

Service website: https://www.euromsgexpress.com/
Service terms: https://www.euromsgexpress.com/en/terms-of-use/
Service privacy policy: https://www.euromsgexpress.com/en/privacy-policy/
Service anti-spam policy: https://www.euromsgexpress.com/en/anti-spam-policy/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the dixjuin-contact-sync-for-euromsg folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Dixjuin Sync admin menu.
  4. Enter the API base URL, clientName, password, API key, and target list ID.
  5. Run the connection test.
  6. Refresh suppressions.
  7. Enable synchronization.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send contacts immediately after activation?

No. Synchronization is disabled by default. Contacts are only sent after an administrator configures the API settings and enables synchronization.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is optional. If WooCommerce is active, the plugin can capture order customer emails. Elementor form sync and CSV import can be used separately.

Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

Elementor form capture uses the Elementor Pro form hook. CSV import and WooCommerce capture do not require Elementor Pro.

How are unsubscribed contacts handled?

The plugin stores local suppression records and can refresh remote suppression signals from Euromsg. Suppressed contacts are not re-sent by the queue.

Are API passwords hard-coded?

No. Credentials are entered in the WordPress admin area and the password is stored encrypted using WordPress salts.
